candidates.rationale: Complete-composition, introduction-commit, and current-corpus review proves the selected span is a separable generic group-reaction aside. The edit preserves terminal-cell geometry, SGR state, palette, neighboring artwork, the retained quotation, and the creator signature. Titles, attribution, identity, dialogue, structural lettering, art-integrated words, and ambiguity remain intact.

normalization: SHA-256 of UTF-8 visible terminal-cell rows after ANSI-control removal and outer-whitespace trimming. Every accepted row pins exact raw projected and rendered hashes plus one-based inclusive blank-column ranges.
policy: Fail-closed review of informal-reaction and laughter cues in every static color-script payload. Accept only complete, separable creator commentary or reaction-aside spans proven non-structural by complete-composition and introduction history; retain titles, signatures, attribution, credits, dialogue, narrative, slogans, structural text, art-integrated words, and ambiguity.
